Hand Hygiene Audit: checks staff compliance with the 5 Moments of Hand Hygiene, use of soap/gel, and availability of facilities.
Infection Prevention & Control Audit: looks at PPE use, isolation precautions, cleaning standards, waste/sharps disposal, and environmental hygiene.
Medicines Management Audit: covers secure storage, controlled drugs, allergy documentation, fridge temperatures, and safe administration.
Falls Prevention Audit: checks completion of falls risk assessments, care plans, equipment access, and incident reporting.
Pressure Ulcer / Skin Integrity Audit: reviews risk assessments, daily skin checks, repositioning, pressure-relieving equipment, and ulcer reporting.
Nutrition & Hydration Audit: covers MUST screening, food/fluid charts, dietitian referrals, and mealtime assistance.
Dignity & Privacy Audit: assesses whether patients are treated respectfully, have privacy during care, and information is kept confidential.
Safeguarding Audit: confirms staff know safeguarding procedures, referrals are made when required, and training is up to date.
Fire Safety Audit: checks fire exits, alarms, extinguishers, evacuation knowledge, and staff training.
Health & Safety / Equipment Audit: reviews moving & handling risk assessments, equipment safety checks, and reporting of accidents/near misses.
